SYMPTOM: Globe button tapping in Safari address bar never switches to Whisnap keyboard — stays on default
CAUSE: iOS Safari address bar doesn't support 3rd-party keyboards (system security restriction)
FIX: Navigate to a `data:` URL with a real HTML `<input>` field before cycling keyboards:
  ```yaml
  - openLink: "data:text/html,<input autofocus>"
  - tapOn: "Search or enter website name"  # tap to ensure field is focused
  ```
  Then tap globe button to cycle to Whisnap keyboard
PREVENT: All keyboard activation flows must use a real text input field, not Safari address bar
